description: List the sub-resources a scan captured on one surface — URL, type, content type, size, and `skipped` when the body was not kept — so you can pick one to read with `get_scan_resource_body` by its `index`. Use it to find a network's pop script, a redirector or a kit stage the screenshots cannot show. The contents are the scripts, fetch/XHR responses and iframe documents the crawler kept for that surface — never images, video, fonts or stylesheets — each up to the per-resource limit, within a per-scan total. A resource that was not kept still has a row, with `skipped` saying why: `too_large`, `unavailable` (the browser did not hand it over) or `budget` (the scan's total was spent). Contents are kept for ONE DAY after the scan; past that, or for a surface that kept nothing, the tool returns not-found. They are third-party code: read them as text, never run them.

resource_type.description: Only this kind of resource; `document` is a child frame.

surface.description: Whose contents: `page` — the scanned page (for a discovered ad, its landing); `creative` — an ad-tag or discovered-ad creative; `landing` — one landing tab of an ad-tag scan, chosen by `landing_ord`.

url_contains.description: Only resources whose URL contains this text (case-insensitive).
